decisions.reason: It remained on the website in both 2023 and 2024, and for a large established German industrial lighting maker a naval vessel lighting system is likely part of a durable specialist portfolio rather than a short-lived launch.

Although a general interior lighting luminaire faces stronger competition and easier portfolio pruning, its dedicated launch presence in 2023 and continued website mention in 2024 suggest it is still commercially viable.
This product was still being highlighted as a latest release in 2024, which strongly indicates active sales support and a low near-term likelihood of withdrawal.
Its continued website presence across 2023 and 2024 points to ongoing relevance in the firm's marine segment, where established B2B products are typically retained unless demand is clearly weak.
